newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-UNDEFEATED NATAL BEAT BOLAND 53-13.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-UNDEFEATED NATAL BEAT BOLAND 53-13.

text.p: Defending champions Natal, the only unbeaten side in this year's Currie Cup competition, posted their 11th successive win of the season with a comfortable 53-13 victory (halftime 25-6) over Boland at Kings Park on Saturday.
Flyhalf Henry Honiball, with two tries in each half, turned in a memorable display to break fullback Andre Joubert's individual Natal record of 33 points in a match.
Honiball was successful with eight kicks out of nine to collect a personal tally of 38 points.

Although Natal ran in seven tries in all, six of which were goaled by Honiball, the match was a relatively scrappy affair. But, held by a spirited Boland defence to an 8-6 lead after 25 minutes, Natal's dominance in possession thereafter kept their viitors out of the game.

Left wing Cabous van der Westhuizen, who came on for the injured Joos Joubert in the 13th minute, scored a first-half try after a long skip pass from Andre Joubert to give him his 81st try for Natal - also an individual record for the province.
Natal - Tries: Henry Honiball (4), Cabous van der Westhuizen, Adrian Garvey, Robert du Preez. Conversions: Honiball (6). Penalties: Honiball (2).
Boland - Try: Stefan Terblanche. Conversion: Francois Horn. Penalties: Horn (2).
